outcome: Surgical site infections (SSIs) following Cesarean Section
cohort: The cohort consisted of 373 women who underwent Cesarean Section at a specialized maternal and pediatric referral district hospital in Kigali, Rwanda, between August 2019 and August 2022.
finding: The cumulative incidence of SSIs following CS was 11.3%, with maternal age >= 35 years being a significant predictor of infection, while urban residence, Ubudehe category 2, procedure duration < 45 min, pre-operative glycaemia >= 70 mg/dL, and pre-operative hematocrit >= 33% were identified as protective factors.
